people_role_pulse_mapping.name: people_role_pulse_mapping
people_role_pulse_mapping.value: ("people"."primary_role" IN ('employee', 'team_lead') AND "people"."pulse_participant" = true) OR ("people"."primary_role" IN ('manager', 'hr', 'hrbp', 'leadership') AND "people"."pulse_participant" = false)

survey_group_states_confirmed_disclosure.name: survey_group_states_confirmed_disclosure_proof_check
survey_group_states_confirmed_disclosure.value: "survey_group_states"."status" <> 'confirmed' OR ("survey_group_states"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_group_states"."reporting_disclosure_version" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("survey_group_states"."reporting_disclosure_version") <> '' AND "survey_group_states"."reporting_disclosure_shown_at" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_group_states"."confirmation_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_group_states"."reporting_disclosure_shown_at" < "survey_group_states"."confirmed_at")

survey_group_states_confirmed_displayed_.name: survey_group_states_confirmed_displayed_summary_proof_check
survey_group_states_confirmed_displayed_.value: "survey_group_states"."status" <> 'confirmed' OR ("survey_group_states"."confirmation_prompt_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_group_states"."ai_summary" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("survey_group_states"."ai_summary") <> '')

survey_question_confirmation_bundles_pur.name: survey_question_confirmation_bundles_purged_content_check
survey_question_confirmation_bundles_pur.value: "survey_question_confirmation_bundles"."purged_at" IS NULL OR ("survey_question_confirmation_bundles"."displayed_text" IS NULL AND "survey_question_confirmation_bundles"."components" IS NULL)

survey_question_insights_score_range.name: survey_question_insights_score_range
survey_question_insights_score_range.value:
(
      "survey_question_insights"."outcome" = 'scored' AND "survey_question_insights"."score" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_question_insights"."score" >= 0 AND "survey_question_insights"."score" <= 100
      AND ("survey_question_insights"."working_insight_id" IS NULL OR mod("survey_question_insights"."score", 1) = 0)
    ) OR ("survey_question_insights"."outcome" = 'insufficient_evidence' AND "survey_question_insights"."working_insight_id" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_question_insights"."score" IS NULL)

survey_question_verdict_receipts_target_.name: survey_question_verdict_receipts_target_kind_check

survey_question_working_insights_purged_.name: survey_question_working_insights_purged_content_check
survey_question_working_insights_purged_.value: "survey_question_working_insights"."purged_at" IS NULL OR ("survey_question_working_insights"."working_summary" IS NULL AND "survey_question_working_insights"."confirmed_semantic_summary" IS NULL AND cardinality("survey_question_working_insights"."source_message_ids") = 0)

report_participant_stop.name: report_participant_stop
report_participant_stop.value: ("survey_report_participants"."collection_stopped_at" IS NULL AND "survey_report_participants"."collection_stop_cause" IS NULL AND "survey_report_participants"."collection_stop_mutation_id" IS NULL) OR ("survey_report_participants"."collection_stopped_at" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_report_participants"."collection_stop_cause" IN ('moved', 'promoted', 'deactivated', 'team_changed', 'unit_changed') AND "survey_report_participants"."collection_stop_mutation_id" IS NOT NULL)

report_scope_kind_check.name: report_scope_kind_check
report_scope_kind_check.value: ("survey_report_scopes"."kind" = 'team' AND "survey_report_scopes"."org_team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_report_scopes"."parent_scope_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("survey_report_scopes"."kind" = 'manager_overall' AND "survey_report_scopes"."org_team_id" IS NULL AND "survey_report_scopes"."parent_scope_id" IS NULL)

engagement_answer_value.name: engagement_answer_value
engagement_answer_value.value: "survey_engagement_answer_revisions"."value" BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND "survey_engagement_answer_revisions"."proof_kind" = 'direct_explicit_answer' AND "survey_engagement_answer_revisions"."contract_version" = 'engagement-1-10-v1' AND "survey_engagement_answer_revisions"."question_version" = "survey_engagement_answer_revisions"."contract_version" AND "survey_engagement_answer_revisions"."permission_revision" >= 0 AND "survey_engagement_answer_revisions"."prompt_sent_at" < "survey_engagement_answer_revisions"."answer_received_at" AND "survey_engagement_answer_revisions"."expires_at" > "survey_engagement_answer_revisions"."answer_received_at"

report_final_timing_shape.name: report_final_timing_shape
report_final_timing_shape.value: ("survey_report_final_timings"."status" = 'blocked' AND "survey_report_final_timings"."blocked_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_report_final_timings"."blocked_reason" IN ('missing_calendar','invalid_calendar','invalid_locale','source_out_of_sync','invalid_cycle','no_working_close_in_cycle','nonexistent_work_end','ambiguous_work_end') AND "survey_report_final_timings"."final_due_at" IS NULL AND "survey_report_final_timings"."formation_started_at" IS NULL AND "survey_report_final_timings"."report_data_cutoff" IS NULL) OR ("survey_report_final_timings"."status" IN ('scheduled','started') AND "survey_report_final_timings"."blocked_reason" IS NULL AND "survey_report_final_timings"."timezone" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_report_final_timings"."local_date" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_report_final_timings"."local_work_end" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_report_final_timings"."final_due_at" IS NOT NULL AND (("survey_report_final_timings"."status" = 'scheduled' AND "survey_report_final_timings"."formation_started_at" IS NULL AND "survey_report_final_timings"."report_data_cutoff" IS NULL) OR ("survey_report_final_timings"."status" = 'started' AND "survey_report_final_timings"."formation_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_report_final_timings"."report_data_cutoff" IS NOT NULL AND "survey_report_final_timings"."report_data_cutoff" = "survey_report_final_timings"."formation_started_at" AND "survey_report_final_timings"."formation_started_at" >= "survey_report_final_timings"."final_due_at")))

report_config_readiness.name: report_config_readiness
report_config_readiness.value: "tenant_report_config_revisions"."revision" > 0 AND ("tenant_report_config_revisions"."unavailable_reason" IS NULL AND "tenant_report_config_revisions"."locale" IS NOT NULL AND "tenant_report_config_revisions"."calendar" IS NOT NULL OR "tenant_report_config_revisions"."unavailable_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "tenant_report_config_revisions"."unavailable_reason" IN ('missing_calendar','invalid_calendar','invalid_locale'))

report_work_stages.name: report_work_stages
report_work_stages.value: "survey_report_inbound_work"."capture" in ('pending','applied','not_applicable','invalid','excluded','expired','deleted','blocked') and "survey_report_inbound_work"."native_verdict" in ('pending','claimed','applied','not_applicable','excluded','expired','deleted','blocked') and "survey_report_inbound_work"."evidence" in ('pending','applied','not_applicable','excluded','expired','deleted','delegated','blocked') and "survey_report_inbound_work"."finalization" in ('pending','applied','not_applicable','excluded','expired','deleted','blocked')
